## Legal Verification Standards
Every plot offered by JameenWale undergoes rigorous revenue title scrutiny:
1. 30-year Registered Sale Deed (Kewala) chain verification
2. Bihar Bhumi portal online Jamabandi cross-verification
3. Circle Office Dakhil-Kharij (Mutation) receipt confirmation
4. Land Possession Certificate (LPC) validation
5. Concrete boundary demarcation with 30-40ft wide internal roads
